tracks.excerpt: An album-length EP by the 20-year-old producer is a dizzying and boundless collage of collages, using free-jazz logic and digital overload to chart new emotional terrain.

tracks.excerpt: For their collaborative full-length debut, Eris Drew and Octo Octa hunkered down in their New Hampshire cabin to craft a celebratory, sample-heavy tribute to the maximalist dance music of yore.

tracks.title: A MAN A CURE
tracks.excerpt: Cork trio Ana Palindrome make a hypnotic blend of art-pop, droning vocals, sawing fiddle, and glitchy folktronica on “A MAN A CURE,” their first release for London’s World of Echo. Beneath its pulsing rhythms and woozy electronics, the track questions the idea of self-made identity, as Niamh Dalton’s voice shifts between the organic and the artificial. The post Ana Palindrome :: A MAN A CURE first
tracks.excerpt_zh: 软木三人组Ana Palindrome在“A MAN A CURE”上融合了流行艺术、嗡嗡声、锯子小提琴和毛骨悚然的民谣，这是他们在伦敦回声世界的首次发行。随着Niamh Dalton的声音在有机音乐和人工音乐之间转换，在它的脉动节奏和昏昏欲睡的电子音乐下，赛道对自制身份的概念提出了质疑。文章Ana Palindrome:: A MAN A CURE first

tracks.title: The thing
tracks.excerpt: The Danish artist achieves a beguiling flow state on her second solo album: a set of future standards full of empty space.
